name: Ostuni (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ostuni (three towers on hills on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ostuni, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ostuni arms — three towers on hills on blue, crowned, within branches
